name: Villers-Bocage
locality: Calvados; arrondissement of Vire; arrondissement of Caen; canton of Villers-Bocage
text: Villers-Bocage (French pronunciation: [vilɛʁ bɔkaʒ] ) is a commune in the Calvados department in the Normandy region in Northern France. The commune is listed as a Village étape.

depictions.name: Villers-Bocage
depictions.text: cod2 Villers-Bocage is a multiplayer map featured in Call of Duty 2. It is set in June of the year 1944. The opposing factions in this map are the British and the Germans.
